about.pageSubtitle: Your trusted partner in investment consultancy and real estate solutions
about.companyDescription: Value Plus Egypt is a premier investment consultancy and real estate services firm established to provide comprehensive solutions for investors, developers, and businesses across Egypt and the Middle East region.
about.missionText: To deliver exceptional investment consultancy and real estate services that empower our clients to make informed decisions, maximize returns, and achieve sustainable growth through data-driven analysis and expert guidance.
about.visionText: To be the leading investment consultancy firm in Egypt and the Middle East, recognized for our integrity, innovation, and commitment to delivering measurable value to every client and project we serve.
about.leaderName: Dr. Eng. Sherif Said El Saftawy
about.leaderBio: Dr. Eng. Sherif Said El Saftawy brings extensive experience in investment consultancy, engineering, and real estate development. Under his leadership, Value Plus Egypt has grown to become a trusted name in feasibility studies, value engineering, and comprehensive real estate services across the region.
about.why1Text: Our team of seasoned professionals brings decades of combined experience in investment, engineering, and real estate.
about.why2Text: We leverage advanced analytical tools and comprehensive market data to deliver accurate, actionable insights.
about.why3Text: From feasibility studies to project completion, we provide end-to-end services that cover every aspect of your investment.
about.why4Text: Deep knowledge of the Egyptian and Middle Eastern markets ensures locally relevant and culturally sensitive solutions.
